pages.text: These artifacts are in the Nuit Pharaoh’s loot pool. Use four matching Torches of Nuit to target it. An untuned ritual can also drop them.
A Curios necklace that hides you while standing still. Movement cancels the effect. Attacking reveals you and delays the next vanishing.
A khopesh that can inflict Wither. In the off hand, it can block like a shield. Pair it with Nuit’s Quarter to strengthen the status effect.
A khopesh that can inflict Weakness. In the off hand, it can block like a shield. Pair it with Nuit’s Ire to strengthen the status effect.
